description.narrative: Insatsen är ett stöd FN:s gemensamma kontor för mänskliga rättigheter (UNJHRO/BCNUDH) i Demokratiska Republiken Kongo (DRK), en sammanslagning av Högkommissarien för Mänskliga Rättigheter (OHCHR) och FN:s fredsbevarande mission MONUSCO i DRK. Stödet utgör en icke-öronmärkt finansiering av landprogrammet under 2026.

The initiative is a support to the UN Joint Human Rights Office (UNJHRO/BCNUDH) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), a merger of the Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) and the UN peacekeeping mission MONUSCO in the DRC. The support constitutes un-earmarked funding of the country programme in 2026.

UNJHRO's Country Program 2024-2027 consists of six pillars with idetified expected results, country results, outcome, outputs and activities.
The six pillars are:
1. Strengthening the rule of law and accountability for human rights violations
2. Enhancing and protecting civic space and people's participation
3. Enhancing equality and countering discrimination
4. Integrating human rights in sustainable development
5. Early warning, prevention, and protection of human rights in situations of conflict.
6. Enhancing Cooperation with the international human rights mechanisms.
